groups.name: No Indication Home RC/Away RC
description: Providers missed or delayed Red Card shown by more than one (1) minute.
=> Missed update Home/Away Red Card score -> But there is Red Card awarded.
Att: Actual goal /red card compare last ticket trans.time base on 1 min to use message type.
Over 1mins consider wrong score/Missed red card: RC 10:00:00, last ticket trans.time 10:01:00.
Within 1mins consider danger accept Goal/red card: RC 10:00:00, last ticket trans.time 10:00:20.
*Home Missed > Request Home.  Away Missed > Request Away.

groups.name: Wrong Indication Home RC/Away RC
description: Providers wrong display Home/Away Red Card and/or in fact there is no Red Card awarded.
=> Wrong update Home/Away Red Card score -> But there is 'No Red Card' awarded.
*Wrong Home RC > Request Home, Wrong Away RC > Request Away. AA:3-PA:3-SA:9
*Wrong Swap team RC: Home RC but show wrong Away RC > Request Away. AA:0-PA:0-SA:0

groups.name: Home RC/Away RC award under Regular Time
description: Red card awarded in between regular time of 75 minutes until full-time completed period. Extra time main match/child match/link match and/or any other related product affected the betting ticket must be voided.
=> Extra time market ticket voiding process of Home/Away team Red Card awarded within the regular time period.
*Home RC > Request Home. Away RC > Request Away

groups.name: Replacement of Sent-Off player
description: This request will be based on the first ticket, 1H and/or FT of the HDP/1x2 acceptance time. User input <Replacement of sent-off player time> to <Removed Red Card time>. TVS will auto search the 1st ticket time of the HDP/1x2 following the given time range, if detected, we need to void. (Use accept time to request)

groups.name: Replacement of Sent-Off player (All)
description: This request will be based on the first ticket of any type of bet. User input <Replacement of sent-off player time> to <Removed Red Card time>. TVS will auto search for the first ticket time for any type of bet within the given time range, If detected have a ticket, we need to void. (Use accept time to request)
